9.question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from DELIVERED orders?

10.question: Show the total revenue (quantity times unit price) for each product category name.
10.sql:
SELECT
  c.category_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories AS c
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY
  c.category_name;
10.detail: 6 row(s) identical to the reference answer

11.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent (quantity times unit price, all orders)? Show full name and total spent.
11.sql:
SELECT
  c.full_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.full_name
ORDER BY
  total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;
11.detail: 5 row(s) identical to the reference answer

12.question: How many reviews has each product received? Show the product name and review count, including products with no reviews.
12.sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN reviews AS r
  ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  p.product_name;
12.detail: 24 row(s) identical to the reference answer

13.question: What is the average rating of each product that has at least one review? Show product name and average rating.
13.sql:
SELECT

  AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM products AS p
JOIN reviews AS r
  ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name;
13.detail: 24 row(s) identical to the reference answer

16.question: For each customer tier, how many customers are there and how many orders have they placed in total?
16.sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS num_customers,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.customer_tier
ORDER BY
  c.customer_tier;
16.detail: 3 row(s) identical to the reference answer

17.question: Find customers who live in Chennai and their order count. Show full name and count.
17.sql:
SELECT
  c.full_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE
  c.city = 'Chennai'
GROUP BY
  c.full_name;

18.question: How many orders were placed in each year and month? Show year, month and count as separate columns.
18.sql:
SELECT
  YEAR(order_date) AS order_year,
  MONTH(order_date) AS order_month,
  COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY
  order_year,
  order_month
ORDER BY
  order_year,
  order_month;

19.question: For each customer who has ordered, show their full name and the date of their most recent order.

20.question: Rank the products within each category by price, highest first. Show category name, product name, price and the rank.
20.sql:
SELECT
  c.category_name,
  p.product_name,
  p.price,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY p.price DESC) AS price_rank
FROM products AS p
JOIN categories AS c
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
ORDER BY
  c.category_name,
  price_rank;
20.detail: 24 row(s) identical to the reference answer

22.question: Which customers have spent more than the average spend per customer (quantity times unit price, counting only customers who have ordered)? Show full name.
22.sql:
SELECT c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > (
    SELECT AVG(total_customer_spend)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS total_customer_spend
        FROM orders o2
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
        GROUP BY o2.customer_id
    ) AS customer_spends
);
22.detail: 23 row(s) identical to the reference answer

23.question: Which customers have reviewed a product that they never ordered? Show the customer's full name and the product name.
23.sql:
SELECT
  c.full_name,
  p.product_name
FROM reviews AS r
JOIN customers AS c
  ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON r.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  (
    r.customer_id,
    r.product_id
  ) NOT IN (
    SELECT
      o.customer_id,
      oi.product_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  );
